drivingQuestion: Which tanna does the mishna follow?
outcomeNote: The mishna is R' Yosei per one of two tannaitic versions of his view.

segments.he: אִי רַבִּי יְהוּדָה, לִיתְנֵי: שָׁבוּ בְּנֵי דָוִד בֶּן יְהוּדָה שְׁנִיָּה! אִי רַבִּי יוֹסֵי, לִיתְנֵי: שָׁבוּ בְּנֵי יוֹאָב בֶּן צְרוּיָה שְׁנִיָּה!
segments.en: The Gemara continues: «If it» represents the opinion of «Rabbi Yehuda, let him teach» that «the descendants of David ben Yehuda returned» for «a second» time on a different date, the twentieth of Elul, as he contends that the descendants of Adin ben Yehuda are the descendants of David. «And if» the mishna represents the opinion of «Rabbi Yosei, let him teach» that the «descendants of Joab, son of Zeruiah, returned» for «a second» time, as he maintains that the descendants of Pahath Moab and the descendants of Adin ben Yehuda are both the descendants of Joab.

segments.he: לְעוֹלָם רַבִּי יוֹסֵי, וּתְרֵי תַנָּאֵי אַלִּיבָּא דְּרַבִּי יוֹסֵי.
segments.en: The Gemara answers: «Actually,» the mishna represents the opinion of «Rabbi Yosei, and» there are «two tanna’im» whose opinion is «in accordance with» the opinion of «Rabbi Yosei.» One tanna maintains that only the descendants of Pahath Moab are the descendants of Joab, while the other claims that only the descendants of Adin ben Yehuda are the descendants of Joab. According to both opinions, neither group was repeated a second time, and therefore the mishna does not pose a difficulty to either of them.

moves.summary: R' Yehuda would have David's family return a second time
R' Yosei would have Joab's family return a second time
It is R' Yosei; two tannaim differ about his view

edges.about: according to R' Yosei, whether Pahath Moab or Adin ben Yehuda are the descendants of Joab

positions.claim: follows R' Yosei as transmitted by one of two tannaim
